listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream packages include Recharged app/runtime+launcher. Select own game image in launcher and Play; first-start prompts follow per-platformguide. Launcher offers in-place updates. Source compilation is distinct from this documented packaged-player flow. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims the whole game, sound/movies/saves and controller modes. WFC online unavailable. A test prerelease must not silently become the stable route. Windows/Linux/macOS/Deck packages generate native program; Nintendo WFC online unavailable. Latest first release entry is test-pr74 prerelease: resolve compatible stable release instead of adopting tag ordering blindly. Upstream platforms: Windows x64, Linux x86-64 Vulkan, SteamOS 3.7+, macOS ARM64 and Intel 15+, explicitly documented. Original data: Wii Mario Strikers Charged own supported disc.
